req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/{squadNumber} must persist updates so subsequent GET calls reflect the change. I identified: (1) a positive EP test confirming 204 + GET reflects new values; (2) a STC test verifying the full state transition from original→updated→re-read; (3) a NEG test for squad-number mismatch (body vs path) returning 400; (4) a NEG test for non-existent squad number returning 404; (5) a BVA test at the boundary of the squad-number match check (body squad_number == path ±1); (6) a DT test covering the boolean combination where squad numbers match but player does not exist. I also noted a deliberate bug in the source: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (the try block returns False instead of True), which means the route always raises HTTP 500 after a successful DB write. Tests are written to assert the SPECIFIED behaviour (204) so they will kill that mutation/bug. All tests use exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update
preconditions: DB contains squad number 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with fully updated payload (squad_number=10 in body)
GET /players/squadnumber/10 and verify all fields match the PUT payload
expected: GET response body reflects every updated field exactly
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "UpdatedFirst",
        "middleName": "UpdatedMiddle",
        "lastName": "UpdatedLast",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "LW",
        "team": "Juventus",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": True
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204

    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "UpdatedFirst"
    assert body["middleName"] == "UpdatedMiddle"
    assert body["lastName"] == "UpdatedLast"
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 10
    assert body["position"] == "Left Winger"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "LW"
    assert body["team"] == "Juventus"
    assert body["league"] == "Serie A"
    assert body["starting11"] is True

tests.name: test_put_persists_state_transition_original_to_updated
preconditions: DB contains squad number 5 (Vivaan Nair, position=Central Midfield)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/5 with changed first_name and position
GET /players/squadnumber/5 again to verify state transition
expected: Initial GET returns firstName=Vivaan, position=Central Midfield
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_persists_state_transition_original_to_updated():
    before = client.get("/players/squadnumber/5")
    assert before.status_code == 200
    before_body = before.json()
    assert before_body["firstName"] == "Vivaan"
    assert before_body["position"] == "Central Midfield"
    original_id = before_body["id"]

    payload = {
        "firstName": "ChangedName",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Nair",
        "dateOfBirth": "1905-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 5,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Independiente",
        "league": "Liga Profesional",
        "starting11": False
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/5", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204

    after = client.get("/players/squadnumber/5")
    assert after.status_code == 200
    after_body = after.json()
    assert after_body["firstName"] == "ChangedName"
    assert after_body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert after_body["id"] == original_id
    assert after_body["squadNumber"] == 5

tests.name: test_put_boundary_squad_number_body_one_above_path_returns_400
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Verify 400 is returned (mismatch check: body != path)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_boundary_squad_number_body_one_above_path_returns_400():
    base_payload = {
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Banerjee",
        "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 2,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Manchester City",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
    resp_mismatch = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=base_payload)
    assert resp_mismatch.status_code == 400

    exact_payload = dict(base_payload)
    exact_payload["squadNumber"] = 1
    resp_match = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=exact_payload)
    assert resp_match.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_decision_table_match_exists_vs_match_not_exists
preconditions: DB contains squad number 3, does NOT contain squad number 50
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/3 with body squadNumber=3 (match + exists) → expect 204
PUT /players/squadnumber/50 with body squadNumber=50 (match + not exists) → expect 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_decision_table_match_exists_vs_match_not_exists():
    payload_exists = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Karan",
        "lastName": "Khan",
        "dateOfBirth": "1903-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 3,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "RB",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "La Liga",
        "starting11": True
    }
    resp_exists = client.put("/players/squadnumber/3", json=payload_exists)
    assert resp_exists.status_code == 204

    payload_not_exists = {
        "firstName": "Nobody",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Ghost",
        "dateOfBirth": "2001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "NoTeam",
        "league": "NoLeague",
        "starting11": False
    }
    resp_not_exists = client.put("/players/squadnumber/50", json=payload_not_exists)
    assert resp_not_exists.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_put_optional_fields_nulled_persists_correctly
preconditions: DB contains squad number 4 (James John Menon, middleName=John)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/4 with middleName=null, abbrPosition=null, team=null, league=null, starting11=null
GET /players/squadnumber/4 and verify optional fields are null/None
expected: GET returns HTTP 200 with all optional fields null
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_optional_fields_nulled_persists_correctly():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "James",
        "middleName": None,
        "lastName": "Menon",
        "dateOfBirth": None,
        "squadNumber": 4,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "abbrPosition": None,
        "team": None,
        "league": None,
        "starting11": None
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/4", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204

    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/4")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "James"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Menon"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 4
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
